from __future__ import annotations
import json
from pathlib import Path
import pytest
from tests.test_harness_blackbox_http import harness


def record(root, name, data):
    (root / (name + '.json')).write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False), encoding='utf-8')


def test_malformed_op_causes_partial_live_apply(harness):
    from web import app as web_app
    web_app.app.config['PROPAGATE_EXCEPTIONS'] = False
    plan = [
        {'op': 'create_file', 'relative_path': 'created.txt', 'content': 'partial write\n'},
        {'op': 7, 'relative_path': 'other.txt'},
    ]
    response = harness.client.post('/apply_patch_plan', headers=harness.headers, data={
        'repo_path': str(harness.repo), 'patch_style': 'balanced', 'apply_policy': 'ask',
        'patch': json.dumps({'patch_basis': 'explicit_change_request', 'patch_plan': plan}),
    })
    evidence = {'http_status': response.status_code, 'created_file_remains': (harness.repo / 'created.txt').exists(),
                'created_content': (harness.repo / 'created.txt').read_text(),
                'response_is_json': response.is_json, 'provider_calls': len(harness.calls)}
    record(harness.root, 'malformed_op_partial_apply', evidence)
    assert evidence['http_status'] == 500
    assert evidence['created_file_remains'] is True
    assert evidence['provider_calls'] == 0


def test_dream_apply_uses_different_report_than_reviewed(harness, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES", str(harness.repo.parent))
    from core import dream_artifacts
    root = dream_artifacts.dreams_root(str(harness.repo)) / '2026-09-11'
    def report(run, filename, title):
        path = root / run
        item_dir = path / '1-item'
        item_dir.mkdir(parents=True)
        plan = [{'op': 'create_file', 'relative_path': filename, 'content': title + '\n'}]
        (item_dir / 'patch_plan.json').write_text(json.dumps(plan), encoding='utf-8')
        data = {'items': [{'idx': 1, 'title': title, 'kind': 'bug', 'status': 'ready_to_apply', 'item_dir_name': '1-item'}]}
        (path / 'list.json').write_text(json.dumps(data), encoding='utf-8')
        return path
    first = report('120000-run', 'reviewed.txt', 'Reviewed item A')
    listed = harness.client.get('/dream/list', query_string={'repo_path': str(harness.repo)}, headers=harness.headers).get_json()
    second = report('120001-run', 'unreviewed.txt', 'Unreviewed item B')
    response = harness.client.post('/dream/apply', headers=harness.headers, data={'repo_path': str(harness.repo), 'selection': '1'})
    result = response.get_json()
    evidence = {'reviewed_report': listed['report_dir'], 'reviewed_item': listed['items'][0]['title'],
                'http_status': response.status_code, 'apply_response': result,
                'reviewed_file_exists': (harness.repo / 'reviewed.txt').exists(),
                'unreviewed_file_exists': (harness.repo / 'unreviewed.txt').exists(), 'provider_calls': len(harness.calls)}
    record(harness.root, 'dream_apply_report_identity', evidence)
    assert listed['items'][0]['title'] == 'Reviewed item A'
    assert result['results'][0]['title'] == 'Unreviewed item B'
    assert result['results'][0]['status'] == 'applied'
    assert evidence['unreviewed_file_exists'] is True
    assert evidence['reviewed_file_exists'] is False
    assert evidence['provider_calls'] == 0


def test_rollback_failure_reports_performed_and_protected(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    from patching.patch_plan_executor import apply_patch_plan
    target = tmp_path / 'app.py'
    before = b'VALUE = 1\n'
    target.write_bytes(before)
    write = Path.write_bytes
    def fail_restore(path, data):
        if path == target and data == before:
            raise PermissionError('injected restore failure')
        return write(path, data)
    monkeypatch.setattr(Path, 'write_bytes', fail_restore)
    result = apply_patch_plan(str(tmp_path), [
        {'op': 'replace_snippet', 'relative_path': 'app.py', 'target_snippet': 'VALUE = 1', 'patched_snippet': 'VALUE = 2'},
        {'op': 'replace_snippet', 'relative_path': 'missing.py', 'target_snippet': 'x', 'patched_snippet': 'y'},
    ])
    evidence = {'result': result, 'final_bytes_hex': target.read_bytes().hex(), 'original_bytes_hex': before.hex(),
                'restore_fault_injected': True}
    record(tmp_path, 'rollback_failure_visibility', evidence)
    assert result['rollback_performed'] is True
    assert result['patch_ops_rollback_protected'] is True
    assert target.read_bytes() != before
    assert 'injected restore failure' not in json.dumps(result)

"""Audit probe: assert the observed UI/auth gap, not a fixed behavior."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
from tests.test_harness_blackbox_http import harness


def test_token_enabled_native_form_has_no_auth_transport(harness):
    page = harness.client.get('/')
    html = page.get_data(as_text=True)
    # The native form has no token transport; an empty submit avoids any model.
    rejected = harness.client.post('/', data={'query': '', 'repo_path': ''})
    allowed = harness.client.post('/', headers=harness.headers,
                                  data={'query': '', 'repo_path': ''})
    result = {
        'page_status': page.status_code,
        'native_form_present': 'id="agentForm"' in html and 'method="POST"' in html,
        'token_header_name_in_rendered_ui': 'X-CATTUS-Web-Token' in html,
        'unauthenticated_form_status': rejected.status_code,
        'unauthenticated_form_reason': 'no token provided' in rejected.get_data(as_text=True),
        'authenticated_control_status': allowed.status_code,
        'provider_calls': len(harness.calls),
        'browser_token_submission_tested': False,
    }
    (harness.root / 'auth-ui.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')
    assert result['page_status'] == 200
    assert result['native_form_present'] is True
    assert result['token_header_name_in_rendered_ui'] is False
    assert result['unauthenticated_form_status'] == 401
    assert result['unauthenticated_form_reason'] is True
    assert result['authenticated_control_status'] == 200
    assert result['provider_calls'] == 0
